title: Turkey bolognese with wholemeal spaghetti
steps: Very finely chop the onion, carrot, celery and garlic and sweat them in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the mince and fry until crumbly, then briefly toast the tomato purée.
Add the passata and oregano, season and simmer gently, covered, for 20 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
Toss with the sauce and serve with Parmesan and basil.
